youtube.title: 門檻｜恁祖媽今年18 第46集
youtube.description: 第33天夜裡，周懷安看完屋、說了「用印改在後天一早」走了。她跪在祠堂的燈前閉眼，耳邊響起七十八年前作甫的聲音：「月棠，地在腳下，家在門裡。」她睜開眼：門檻。福伯來鎖祠堂，她問大門的門檻換過沒有，福伯說七十年沒換過；她說七十八年前，她把地契埋在了門檻底下。凌晨一點，全家睡熟，她、知遠和福伯打開大門，知遠撬起厚木門檻，底下的石槽裡是一層泥。知遠要用鏟子，她要用手，福伯拿著鐵鏟不知道該聽誰的。手指碰到油紙的時候，撬棍敲在石槽上那一聲吵醒了林美鳳，她從西迴廊的樓梯下來問是誰在前面敲；三個人僵在門檻邊。替他們擋下來的是二房的知行：「媽，沒事，貓。」油紙包打開，是一張民國三十七年的地契，所有權人沈月棠；房契在建邦那裡，地契一直在門檻下。福伯說這要本人才能用，她看著自己十八歲的手：「那我就本人。」

data.prompt: At the black-lacquered double gate of the old Shen house in the dead of night, the camera low by the stone trough looking up; the only light is a cold white phone torch from the upper left and a warm red candle on a small white porcelain dish from the lower right. Three people: in the middle Shen Yuetang kneels by the trough holding the opened oiled paper and the yellowed document in both hands, blank back to the camera; on screen left Shen Zhiyuan in his charcoal overcoat holding up the phone torch; on screen right Fu Bo holding the iron shovel; a red candle before her left knee; the threshold leans on the left door leaf. She looks down at her young hands holding the document and the silver ring, then slowly raises her eyes toward the black lane outside. Shen Yuetang speaks a short Mandarin line, her lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, soft and certain. The two men keep their mouths closed.
